notes.title: "EXIT - The Curse of Ophir" launching 6/29 on STEAM
notes.notes:
Play the successful EXIT - Adventure on your PC or MAC now! 

"EXIT - The Curse of Ophir" was released in the fall of 2021 for iOs and Android and is the first-ever digital adaptation of the most successful german boardgame series “EXIT® - The Game”

In the “EXIT® - The Game” series you solve creative puzzles to escape dicy situations you find yourself in. 

"EXIT - The Curse of Ophir" offers completely new puzzles for all fans of the board game series including the typical "outside-of-the-box" puzzles. Everything can be part of the puzzle. 

All new fans will be presented with easy-to-learn tutorials and the hint system that will allow them to get a little help if needed. 

The STEAM version features puzzles customized for the platform, as well as Achievements for each puzzle and Easteregg found. 

If you are a fan of clever puzzle design and enjoy a challenge then "EXIT - The Curse of Ophir" might be the game for you.

notes.title: EXIT - Trial of the Griffin now availabe
notes.notes:
Hi EXIT fans, 

Do you want more mind-bending puzzles then check out EXIT - The Trial of the Griffin. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42537348/d177e4e977e66cdd3e7d725a01f1fd3870db584f.png[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2110690/EXIT_The_Game__Trail_of_the_Griffin/

The game takes place in the year 1837 at the legendary Greifenstein Castle.

The Countess herself has invited you to assist her as an expert. Neither the bumpy carriage ride through the misty woods nor the locals' warnings can deter you. But what is the truth behind the rumors about the Countess not being seen for decades and that ghosts haunt the stone halls of Greifenstein?
Once you arrive at the castle, the old walls won't let you go. Only if you pass the trials of the Countess and prove yourself worthy, you can free her - and yourself - from the castle and lift the curse.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42537348/a89ee43bc5bc89512a2f4852cc7c315c5064e6c7.png[/img]

Go in search of the castle's mistress, examine her chambers for artifacts from your predecessors, rummage through the library for clues about the von Greifenstein family, discover mysterious relics in the castle courtyard, solve tricky puzzles in the family crypt, and even think beyond the castle - and the game. The ghosts will help you decipher witchcraft recipes, open folios, medallions and caskets, as well as the strange hourglass. Are you up for the task and can you free the Countess from her seemingly hopeless situation?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42537348/26a4fa08a7fd0c515ae716731809513f15313cef.png[/img]
